speaker: narrator
text: In May 2010, almost a trillion dollars vanishes from the US stock market in minutes, and you're the agent sent to find out why.

speaker: narrator
text: Within twenty minutes, most of it is back.

speaker: narrator
text: Someone keeps placing enormous orders to sell, then changing them before anyone can buy.

speaker: narrator
text: Fake orders, to push the price down.

speaker: narrator
text: On crash day: eighty-one thousand changes.

speaker: narrator
text: Five years, you hunt a mastermind.

speaker: narrator
text: It's a real case: a trader, Navinder Sarao, arrested April 2015.

speaker: narrator
text: Regulators said he contributed to the crash, not caused it alone.

speaker: narrator
text: The sentence: a year confined to his home.

speaker: narrator
text: Not every order on the screen is real.
